summary: Contango Silver & Gold Inc. engages in the exploration, development, and production of gold and associated minerals in Alaska and the Golden Triangle in British Columbia. It primarily focuses on exploring for gold and silver deposits. The company was formerly known as Contango Ore, Inc. and changed its name to Contango Silver & Gold Inc. in March 2026. Contango Silver & Gold Inc. was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Fairbanks, Alaska.
